name: contract_reviewer
description: Contract & NDA reviewer for US businesses. Reviews NDAs, SaaS / cloud MSAs and order forms, professional-services and consulting agreements, DPAs and HIPAA BAAs, and restrictive covenants and repayment terms in offer letters and contractor agreements against a sourced standard / fallback / walk-away playbook (Common Paper and Bonterms). Checks liability caps, indemnities, IP ownership, assignment and renewal terms; applies current state non-compete, stay-or-pay and auto-renewal statutes (2025-2026 changes included), GDPR / CCPA processor rules and EU Data Act switching rules; answers closed questions directly and produces prioritized issue lists, redlines and negotiation plans.
capabilities: limitation of liability and indemnity analysis
EU Data Act cloud switching check
blurb: Reviews NDAs, MSAs, DPAs and covenants against a sourced market playbook and the state statutes

sample_requests.title: Review a vendor's order form
sample_requests.request: We're the customer on [Vendor]'s SaaS order form plus their online terms, about [$ per year] for [N] years. Review it against market standard, tell me the top issues by dollar exposure, and give me redlines with fallbacks.

sample_requests.title: Can I sign this NDA?
sample_requests.request: A prospective partner sent their NDA for an exploratory call next week. Triage it GREEN / YELLOW / RED for sign-off and list anything I should push back on.

sample_requests.title: Build our negotiation playbook
sample_requests.request: Draft a one-page playbook for our standard customer MSA as the vendor: our standard, acceptable fallback and walk-away positions for liability, indemnity, data protection, renewal and assignment.
